title: RAG Health
description: Judge faithfulness/relevance trends and retrieval-miss rate from document grading.

panels.title: Faithfulness Score Trend
panels.description: Average Self-RAG faithfulness score (are drafted claims grounded in graded-relevant KB documents?) per day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time, AVG(judge_faithfulness_score) AS avg_faithfulness
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND judge_faithfulness_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Relevance Score Trend
panels.description: Average Self-RAG relevance score (does the drafted response actually address the ticket?) per day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time, AVG(judge_relevance_score) AS avg_relevance
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND judge_relevance_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Retrieval-Miss Rate
panels.description: Share of tickets where the CRAG grader found zero relevant documents among all retrieved+rewritten-query candidates -- these are the tickets a KB-coverage gap, not a model problem, is most likely to explain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(num_relevant_documents = 0), COUNT(*)) AS retrieval_miss_rate
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Relevant / Candidate Document Ratio
panels.description: Average fraction of retrieved candidates the CRAG grader actually marked relevant -- a proxy for retrieval precision independent of the judge's downstream faithfulness score.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time,
  AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(num_relevant_documents, num_kb_candidates)) AS avg_relevant_ratio
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND num_kb_candidates > 0
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
